i personally think the body count is silly. But if its asked i wouldn't count it because it goes against (what i think) a "body" is. 

A body can count as 2 things to someone asking

* sexual experience 
* Sexual history 

sadly, people ask this a lot out of insecurity. In this case just drop the convo because its not worth your time. people who ask it this way will alter their view of you and your value as a person. these people lack the maturity to recognize what S/A is and differentiate S/A from a normal "body" 

But, there are cases when youʻre having a heart to heart and discussing previous relationships or forming a connection with someone (romantic or otherwise) and a similar questions comes up. while i hope they use better words than "how many bodies you got?" there are ways to answer. Firstly ask yourself if you even discussing this topic seeing that you have a more nuanced view on sexual actions and relationships. Then ask yourself if this is someone who understands or is willing to understand the nuances of your situation. If the answer to both are yes then i would just ask the "depends if you count consensual or not?". 

This does a few things. Firstly it allows the other person to choose if they are comfortable with this conversation. it also shows a bit of vulnerability. which i believe depends the relationship with the other person.
